description: Get one shipping rate table with its rates, rateIds, regions, and shipping costs (Account API v2 getRateTable). Pass rateTableId from ebay_get_rate_tables; use the rateIds with ebay_update_rate_table_shipping_cost. Rate tables are supported on US, CA, GB, DE, AU, FR, IT and ES. Requires sell.account or sell.account.readonly.

rateTableId.description: Shipping rate table ID (from Account API v1 getRateTables)

name: ebay_get_rate_table
